requirements_summary: Workloads: low-latency in-app chat (99th p95 target < 150ms for internal path), embeddings for semantic search, nightly batch embedding runs.
Throughput target: baseline 12 req/s for chat flows (peak 80 req/s during launch windows), embeddings: 30k vectors/day.
Latency & SLA: want 95p <= 200ms for short prompts; p99 soft target; require token-level latency breakdowns in console.
Models: prefer open models (Llama2/Redwood-verified variants) with option to route to higher-capacity model for fallback; quantized variants acceptable for non-chat workloads.
Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to smaller model when Dedicated capacity exhausted; also cross-region failover for EU customers.
Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2-level attestations, audit logs retention 2 years, KMS integration for key control, data residency partitioning for EU customers.
Ops: want canary rollouts, per-route metrics, token cost estimates per route, and recommended batching configs for nightly jobs.
pricing_concerns: Prefers three-tier commit proposal: 6-month pilot commit, 12-month standard, 24-month discounted commit.  Wants sample ARR math.
Baseline ask: equivalent of 200k tokens/day committed; want 2x burst buffer (free or discounted) for marketing spikes for first 90 days.
Overage model request: clear per-token overage with monthly cap; finance prefers predictable overage banding vs pure pay-as-you-go to avoid surprises.
Ramp schedule: month-by-month scale path (Month1: 2 GPUs, Month2: 3 GPUs, Month3: 4 GPUs) + option to increase burst by approval flow.
Discount asks: 20-30% on list for 12mo commit; additional 5% for paying upfront; asks for credits during migration/POC period.
Billing cadence: prefers monthly billing with committed credit drawdown; finance open to quarterly invoicing for higher commit tiers.
Request for example invoice simulations (3 sample months) showing committed vs burst vs overage charges.
